heading: Providing proof of rent arrears
paragraphs: You must provide proof of how rent arrears have built up over time. You can either:
bullets: upload a rent statement that follows the guidelines below

contentBlocks.heading: Guidelines for uploading a rent statement

contentBlocks.text: A bank statement will not be accepted. Your rent statement must show:

bullets: every date when a payment was supposed to be made
the amount that was due on each of those dates
the actual payments that were made, and when they were made
the running total of rent arrears

contentBlocks.text: It must cover the time period of either:

bullets: from the first date the defendants missed a payment
the last two years of payments, if the first date of their missed payment was more than two years ago
